sections.title: Sheet Builder
items: Launched the character sheet builder as its own major version line, starting at 2.0 — everything below is new to this tool.
All sheet art (frame, stat icons, fonts, region icons, backgrounds) now streams live from the iuhence/genshin GitHub repo instead of local files.

sections.title: Character Selection & Portrait
items: Default character on load is now the Traveler instead of a blank placeholder, and re-selecting the currently active character no longer wipes its skill/constellation/material data.
Character names render in their natural case ("Kamisato Ayaka") instead of forced ALL CAPS, and the element theme row is now a read-only display driven by the character instead of a manual toggle.

Rebuilt the character portrait: shows the character's namecard art faded and tinted to their element behind a full-height icon, with a rarity star badge in the corner and an edge fade so wide portraits no longer crop with a hard cut.

Every panel header now carries a fading namecard background in the character's element color; the Traveler, Aloy, and other characters without a real Teyvat region get a starfield background instead, on both the header and the main sheet background.

sections.title: Materials Panel
items: Ascension and Talent material costs now auto-fill straight from the character API — correctly grouped into common drops, talent books, Mora, and Crown of Insight — while staying manually editable.
Redesigned material tiles as icon-badge pills instead of plain squares, and fixed a layout bug where they could overflow their grid and overlap neighboring panels.

sections.title: Weapons
items: Replaced rotated diamond weapon slots with square tiles, freeing up space for bigger icons and tighter, more even spacing.
Weapon picker now only shows weapons matching the selected character's weapon type, sorted by rarity.
Added a refinement (R1–R5) badge to every weapon slot, invisible until set so unrefined slots stay clean.

sections.title: Skill Priority & Constellation
items: The ">" / "x" operators between Skill, Burst, and Normal are now click-to-cycle, including a "None" state that leaves blank space instead of an empty circle.

Picking a constellation icon now sets its level and title automatically instead of typing them in by hand; the description field stays manually editable and now supports ++highlight++ text like Notes.

sections.title: Picker Modals
items: Character, weapon, synergy, and artifact pickers now show icon-only tiles at a much larger size instead of icon-plus-name rows, with search still working by name.
Character and weapon tiles are tinted by rarity (gold/purple/blue/green/grey for 5★ down to 1★), matching the color already used for synergy tiles on the sheet.
Widened the modal and tightened spacing so more tiles fit on screen per scroll.

sections.title: Homepage Rebuild
items: Added a "What's New" callout with Characters and Artifacts grids, plus a plain "Character Guides" list linking to real guide pages, each tagged New/Buffed/Stellar.
Added this changelog as an in-page modal instead of a dead link, opened from a new header button.
Added Characters/Weapons quick-nav buttons to the header, next to Changelog and the Star Rail cross-link.

sections.title: Layout & Spacing
items: Increased and unified the sidebar-clearance margin across every page — including the combat pages, which had their own separate value until now.
Moved page-root spacing into a single shared .main-page class instead of each page re-declaring the same margin formula.

sections.title: Mobile Pass
items: Collapsed the header to icon-only buttons on narrow screens and hid the Characters/Weapons pills there, since the bottom nav bar already covers them.
Tightened padding and card sizing on the homepage callout boxes and this changelog modal for small viewports.

sections.title: Header & Theme Overhaul
items: Replaced the sticky header with a Snezhnaya-branded bar, and moved the site logo down to the footer.
Reworked light/dark mode into a purple-and-white / blue-and-black color system, with a sliding toggle switch instead of an icon button.

sections.title: Character & Weapon Pages
items: Switched character and weapon icons to a portrait 3:4 crop to keep every card the same size.
Migrated character data over to the Yatta API and hid elementless characters (like Manekin) from the roster.

sections.title: Layout Unification
items: Centralized page spacing behind shared CSS variables, so the sidebar and header gap stay consistent across every page.
Added a non-sticky footer with Discord/Twitter links and an intellectual property notice.

sections.title: Filter & Grid Styling
items: Retheme filter buttons and grid panels across the character, weapon, artifact, and enemy pages.
Fixed icon-tile filter buttons washing out in light mode by giving them a fixed dark purple background.
